affected_subject.reason: Identifies setDefaultNoCapLimit and market init reading tokenNoCapLimit[baseToken] into noCapLimit.

trigger_or_action.reason: Governance calls setDefaultNoCapLimit(quoteToken, x) and markets are instantiated under that quote.

direct_effect.reason: Quote-level cap setting is silently ignored; markets do not inherit intended cap, leaving them unbounded or overly restricted.

safety_relation_basis.reason: Documented quote-token policy vs actual baseToken lookup yields expected-vs-actual configuration mismatch.

summary: Report explains the misconfigured cap policy: documented quote-token default is ignored because init reads baseToken, producing unintended cap behavior in new markets.
